motions.item_title: Approve the June 18,2019 minutes. Board Member Clark seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Col…
motions.motion: Board Member Gricius moved to approve the June 18,2019 minutes. Board Member Clark seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, Donna Burnham, Stephanie Gricius, and Benjamin Reaves. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: June 18 minutes approved
motions.summary: The agency board approved the minutes of its June 18, 2019 meeting.
motions.impact: Nobody outside the agency's record book feels this one. It makes the written account of the June meeting official.

motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to approve a resolution approving a CRA participation agreement between the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Eagle Mountain City, Oquirrh Wood Ranch, LLC, Utah County, and Tyson Fresh Meais, Inc., and allow City staff and the City Attorney to make small changes to the agreement that maintain the integrity Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City Board Meeting - September 3,2019 Page I of2 of the document Board Member Gricius seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, Donna Burnham, Stephanie Gricius, and Benjamin Reaves. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Tax deal with Tyson and Oquirrh Wood Ranch
motions.summary: The agency board approved a community reinvestment area participation agreement with Eagle Mountain City, Oquirrh Wood Ranch, Utah County and Tyson Fresh Meats, letting staff make minor wording changes.
motions.impact: The agreement binds the agency, the city, Utah County and two companies, but the motion states no dollar figures or term. Nothing on your tax bill changes today, and the city attorney can still adjust the wording before every party signs.
